# Remotion Render

The export reference for Remotion projects: render a video with npx remotion render, a still with npx remotion still, or selected frames as images in one call, plus a full companion guide to transparent video (ProRes 4444 for editing software, WebM VP9 for browsers) via CLI flags, Studio defaults or per-composition metadata. Everything runs locally on the user's own project through the Remotion CLI; no licence was found anywhere in the upstream repository at the pinned commit — see the licence note on this listing. Curated by Skill Harbor — Remotion Render, by @remotion-dev, listed here with credit to its creator. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
